description: Hydropower Droughts Reveal Hidden Adjustment Risks in Global Electricity Transitions Hydropower Droughts Reveal Hidden Adjustment Risks in Global Electricity Transitions is a data set deposited in ScienceDB (Science Data Bank) by its authors Ming Chen (Yunnan Normal University). Clean-generation shares describe composition but not how a power system absorbs a hydroclimatic shock. We combine a 2005–2023 global country-year panel with capacity-weighted exposure from 7,156 hydroelectric plants and an independent crosswalk linking 3,516 plants to ReGeom/GRanD reservoirs within 25 km. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 6758681 bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-sciencedb-repository.
